text_markup: {term:Dividends} is a keyword that represents a conditional ability. "Dividends N" means "When you score this agenda, place N agenda counters on it for each hosted advancement counter past its advancement requirement.".
text_plain: Dividends is a keyword that represents a conditional ability. "Dividends N" means "When you score this agenda, place N agenda counters on it for each hosted advancement counter past its advancement requirement.".

examples.text_markup: The Corp scores {card:Embedded Reporting} with 5 advancement counters on it. The Corp will put 4 agenda counters on the agenda in their score area, 2 agenda counters for each of the 2 excess advancement counters.
examples.text_plain: The Corp scores Embedded Reporting with 5 advancement counters on it. The Corp will put 4 agenda counters on the agenda in their score area, 2 agenda counters for each of the 2 excess advancement counters.
